description: Phase 4 deterministic routing policy. Claim and provider sections are strictly separate - no cross-loading. Every threshold below is anchored to a documented statistic of the SAME held-out calibration-test split used by the calibration artifacts (never invented). Comparisons: calibrated risk escalates with '>= threshold'; signal counts escalate with '>= count'; predicate risk_check passes only when calibrated < full_investigation_risk_threshold.

threshold_provenance.population: claim calibration-test split = Claim_Year == 2023 rows of data/claimsfinal_with_target.csv (15,766 rows, the same held-out split the claim calibration artifact was fitted on)
threshold_provenance.full_investigation_risk_threshold: p95 of calibrated risk on that split = 58.7591
threshold_provenance.fast_track_risk_threshold: p75 of calibrated risk on that split = 25.1098
threshold_provenance.supporting_signals: count of Analytical Engine signals with severity High or Medium on a 3,000-row subsample (random_state=42) of the same split; fast_track = p90 = 8, full_investigation = p95 = 9 (max observed 10)
threshold_provenance.note: auto-approve additionally requires ALL predicates to pass; it only means the case satisfies this configured automated policy, not that legitimacy is proven

threshold_provenance.population: provider calibration-test split = reproduced stratified 70/15/15 TEST part (train_test_split test_size=0.30 then 0.50, random_state=42) of data/Provider_with_potential_fraud.csv (181,121 rows; percentiles computed on a 30,000-row subsample, random_state=42)
threshold_provenance.full_investigation_risk_threshold: p75 of calibrated risk on that split = 100.0 (p90 and p95 are also exactly 100.0 - the top quarter of the held-out provider population saturates at calibrated 100, so 100.0 is the first non-degenerate escalation anchor)
threshold_provenance.fast_track_risk_threshold: p50 of calibrated risk on that split = 53.1561 (p75 collapses to the saturated 100.0 band, so p50 is used to keep a non-empty fast-track band)
threshold_provenance.supporting_signals: count of Analytical Engine signals with severity High or Medium on a 3,000-row subsample (random_state=42) of the same split; fast_track = p75 = 6, full_investigation = p90 = 7 (max observed 11)
threshold_provenance.note: provider cases predicted 'Suspicious' fail prediction_check and therefore route to full_investigation regardless of calibrated risk - a non-legitimate case type is a deterministic escalation

architecture_rule_for_future_llm_phase: The routing layer decides the route. The LLM explains the route. The LLM must eventually be called for EVERY route including auto_approve, and auto_approve must not bypass the future LLM explanation. The LLM never determines the route.
